import asyncio,hashlib,json,os,runpy
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
state_path=root/"attempt.json"
state=json.loads(state_path.read_bytes())
data=json.loads((root/"result.json").read_bytes())
if (state.get("kind")!="maskgw-worker-errors-pg16" or state.get("desktop_initial")!="off"
    or state.get("desktop_started_by_attempt") is not True or state.get("stop_allowed") is not True
    or data.get("owned_cleanup") is not True or data.get("inventory_restored") is not True
    or data.get("profile")!="worker-errors-pg16" or data.get("task")!=state.get("task")):
    raise SystemExit(2)
helper=Path("C:/Users/w.filho/Desktop/codes/mask/docs/poc/run_linux_as_probe.py")
cli=Path("C:/Users/w.filho/AppData/Local/Programs/DockerDesktop/resources/bin/docker.exe")
if (hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!="58c692a775a2dffdaa6be86866cdb15ddb307f97aeb8a04b4f7c737ea56c3627"
    or hashlib.sha256(cli.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!="60028870931ea6e91955bfeaee358ec6c6920f6162c17a3d828c3c82ab3c3599"):
    raise SystemExit(2)
home=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
meta=home/".docker/contexts/meta/fe9c6bd7a66301f49ca9b6a70b217107cd1284598bfc254700c989b916da791e/meta.json"
if (hashlib.sha256((home/".docker/config.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()!="f173396ef80b3c0bf4f8a5f6f944d3e426cee041ae3a2a8a07602ff6846a9f1a"
    or hashlib.sha256(meta.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!="c16649b1a2f1c6fbb68b85158a956862331e86543e25df46341f5fe5df2f9a25"):
    raise SystemExit(2)
state["stop_allowed"]=False
state["restore_invoked"]=True
state_path.write_text(json.dumps(state),encoding="utf8")
bounded=runpy.run_path(str(helper))["bounded"]
record={"profile":"worker-errors-pg16","stop_attempted":False,"outcome":"PENDING"}
try:
    rc,raw=asyncio.run(bounded([str(cli),"ps","-aq","--no-trunc"],limit=16384,timeout=5))
    record["inventory_exit"]=rc
    record["inventory_empty"]=rc==0 and not raw.strip()
    if not record["inventory_empty"]:
        raise ValueError("INTERFERENCE")
    record["stop_attempted"]=True
    rc,_=asyncio.run(bounded([str(cli),"desktop","stop","--timeout","20"],limit=16384,timeout=25))
    record["stop_exit"]=rc
    record["outcome"]="STOP_RETURNED_ZERO" if rc==0 else "NOT_CONFIRMED"
except Exception:
    record["outcome"]="NOT_CONFIRMED"
(root/"restore.json").write_text(json.dumps(record),encoding="utf8")
print(json.dumps(record))
raise SystemExit(0 if record["outcome"]=="STOP_RETURNED_ZERO" else 2)
